resumen: A step to the side, bending that knee and keeping the other leg straight. It is the only pattern in the catalogue that works sideways.
ejecucion: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet together.
Take a wide step to one side and bend that knee, pushing the hip back.
The other leg stays straight, foot flat on the floor.
Chest faces forward and the back stays flat.
Push off the bent leg to return to the middle, and alternate sides.
matices: This pattern fills a gap: almost everything else in the catalogue moves forward or up. In the cited work the lateral lunge activated adductor longus considerably less than squeezing a ball between the knees, so as adductor work it is moderate; its value is in learning to brake the body sideways.
